evidence.excerpt: Todić prefers industry collaborations that involve concrete measurement tasks his laboratory is equipped to perform; he is cautious about projects requiring significant travel commitments during the academic semester. His doctoral student Tamara Nikolić is available for short-term secondments at partner sites.
